rationale.conceptual: The task involves applying a known methodology (DFT+SOI) to compute orbital magnetization and optical conductivity, but requires careful implementation of spin-orbit coupling, correct symmetry operations for averaging orbital moments, and extraction of the antisymmetric conductivity tensor. This is an established but non-trivial method needing domain-specific knowledge and careful coding.
rationale.execution: The pipeline includes setting up and running nine SOC-DFT calculations (3 compounds × 3 spin orientations), then post-processing for orbital magnetization and optical conductivity. This involves multiple stages (structure setup, SCF, SOC, analysis, conductivity), tooling with DFT codes, and data handling, making it a moderately complex multi-stage workflow.
